spec:
Write mdhtml.py with `render(md: str) -> str` converting a Markdown subset to HTML; output blocks are joined with " "; one final newline at the end of the input is ignored. Blocks: ATX headings `# ` to `###### ` (a space is required; trailing #s and spaces stripped) -> ; a line of 3+ of the same char among - * _ (after strip) ->
; fenced code: a ``` line with an optional language, verbatim lines until the closing ``` (or end of input) -> 
...
(no class attribute without a language; content HTML-escaped, lines joined by , no inline formatting); blockquote: consecutive lines starting with `>` (strip `>` and one following space) ->
{render(inner)}
, recursively; unordered list: lines starting `- `, `* ` or `+ ` ->
  • ..
    • ..
; ordered list: lines `N. ` ->
    (or
      when the first number is not 1); a plain non-blank line right after a list item continues that item (joined with a space); paragraphs: consecutive other non-blank lines, stripped and joined with ->

      . Blank lines end paragraphs and lists. Inline (headings, list items, paragraphs): HTML-escape & < > " first; backslash before one of \ ` * _ [ ] ( ) # gives that literal char; `code` spans (content escaped, no further formatting); **strong** and __strong__ -> ; *em* and _em_ -> (an opening marker must be followed and a closing one preceded by a non-space; nesting allowed; an unmatched marker stays literal); [text](url) -> text with formatting allowed in text. Standard library only.
